item.title: Doctors in Brazil using tilapia fish skin to treat burn victims
item.description:
📝 They are covered in fish skin — specifically strips of sterilized tilapia. Edmar Maciel, a plastic surgeon and burn specialist leading the clinical trials with tilapia skin. They are also conducting studies on the comparative costs of tilapia skin and conventional burn treatments.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/brazilian-city-uses-tilapia-fish-skin-treat-burn-victims

item.title: From stealth blackout to whitelisting: Inside the Iranian shutdown
item.description:
📝 From our perspective, this is what IPv6 traffic to Iran looked like on January 8. The drop continued until internet traffic into Iran had all but ceased by 1845 UTC, as illustrated below. Although IPv4 routes remained online, internet traffic stopped for roughly 90 million Iranians.
🔗 Read more: https://www.kentik.com/blog/from-stealth-blackout-to-whitelisting-inside-the-iranian-shutdown/
